items.title: Injectivity is equivalent to vanishing of first Ext against every module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises injective modules by the vanishing of the first Ext group against every module. The proof is a direct reading of the long exact sequence of Ext groups associated with a short exact sequence: vanishing of Ext in degree one makes the Hom functor exact at the relevant spot, which is precisely injectivity, while the converse direction is quoted from the standard identification of the Ext groups with the derived functors of Hom, where injectivity makes the higher derived functors vanish. Both implications are short and are carried by the displayed exact sequence.
